text: {"lessons":["I should avoid selling winners merely to lock in gains; evaluate each holding's outlook and portfolio role rather than anchoring on my average cost.","A loss is painful, but selling at a loss should depend on whether the investment case has changed—not on the desire to avoid realizing it or on the loss alone.","Before buying more, including Stock B, check position size, diversification, and downside risk; frequent account checks can encourage unnecessary trading."]}
